description: Establish the merged monorepo baseline and workspace/build integration that lets GenOffice's multi-app structure live inside redrob-office. This adopts GenOffice's structure as the new base (approach a). Confirm the existing baseline is green first, then set up the workspace layout, license/notice preservation, and build-system wiring that all later port features depend on. NO editor code is written by hand here.
steps: Load Node 22 via nvm and corepack pnpm; run `pnpm install` at /projects/sandbox/redrob-office and confirm the current baseline is green: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test` all pass on the fresh feat/genoffice-port-full branch BEFORE any changes. Record the baseline numbers.

Remove the untracked leftover dist-only dirs from the rejected attempt if present: packages/docx-editor, packages/sheets-editor, packages/slides-editor, packages/pdf-editor, packages/markdown-editor (verify with `git ls-files` that they are NOT tracked on this branch before removing). Also remove any untracked office/src-tauri, office/dist-tauri, office/resources leftovers only if untracked and unrelated to main.

Decide and document the workspace layout in a short design note at .agents/tasks/task-genoffice-port-full/PORT-DESIGN.md: GenOffice apps are self-contained Electron workspaces (React 19, electron-vite) and will be copied verbatim under a new top-level `apps/` directory in redrob-office; GenOffice packages copied verbatim under `packages/` keeping their @genoffice/* names initially (rebranded later). The existing @redrob/office app and @redrob/* packages remain. This preserves original code rather than rewriting it.

Update pnpm-workspace.yaml to add `apps/*` alongside `office` and `packages/*`. Update root turbo.json only if needed so `build`/`typecheck`/`test` globs reach the new apps/packages (turbo picks up workspaces automatically; verify no task-name collisions). Do NOT break the existing @redrob/office tasks.

Port the Apache-2.0 compliance artifacts from GenOffice: copy /projects/sandbox/_refs/genoffice/LICENSE-UNICODE.txt to repo root; merge GenOffice NOTICE (Mainfunc, Inc. copyright) into the existing NOTICE without deleting existing entries; copy tools/gen-third-party-notices.mjs and tools/check-licenses.mjs into a repo tools/ dir. Keep the existing root LICENSE (Apache-2.0). Add an entry recording rhwp MIT (Copyright 2025-2026 Edward Kim). Do NOT remove any upstream copyright.
Verify `pnpm install` still resolves the workspace with apps/* added (empty apps/ dir is fine at this point) and `pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test` still pass with no apps yet ported.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test` pass on branch feat/genoffice-port-full before and after this feature's non-code changes.
pnpm-workspace.yaml includes apps/* and the workspace resolves with `pnpm install` exiting 0.

Root NOTICE contains both the pre-existing Redrob entries and the GenOffice/Mainfunc Apache-2.0 copyright; LICENSE-UNICODE.txt exists at repo root; tools/gen-third-party-notices.mjs and tools/check-licenses.mjs are present.
The rejected-attempt leftover *-editor dist dirs are removed and PORT-DESIGN.md documents the copy-verbatim layout decision.
verification: `export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22; pnpm install && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test` from repo root all exit 0
`cat pnpm-workspace.yaml` shows apps/* ; `ls tools/gen-third-party-notices.mjs LICENSE-UNICODE.txt` succeeds
findings:
Merged-monorepo baseline established. No editor code written or ported (correct for FEAT-001).

Environment: Node v22.23.2 via nvm, pnpm 9.15.0 via corepack. Commands run from repo root with `export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22`.
